name: nourish-wellness-platform
description: Nourish - Holistic Wellness & Appointment Management Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
